ns2:section.sectionText: This course will introduce students to influential, landmark papers in the area of fisheries ecology, human dimensions and management that have made significant advancements in fisheries science. Through weekly readings and discussions, students will be introduced to key papers that have defined the field and will gain a better understanding of the lasting impact these studies have had on this fisheries science. Students will be responsible for leading a single, 1-hour discussion period where a key paper in fisheries science will be discussed and its impacts on the field explored.
